Metadata.title: Talkinu
Metadata.description: Focused 15-minute English speaking practice with human teachers. AI assists. Teachers teach.

Home.title: Speak English for 15 focused minutes with a real teacher
Home.description: Talkinu is built around exactly 15-minute speaking sessions. Teachers teach. AI analyzes. You improve.
Home.trustDurationBody: Every speaking session is a bounded, bookable 15-minute conversation. No open-ended class blocks.
Home.trustTeachersBody: Approved teachers run the session. Talkinu does not replace the teacher with a chatbot.
Home.trustAiBody: Analysis is designed to support the teacher and the learner. It is not a substitute for the lesson.
Home.browseDescription: Browse public teachers by the fields Talkinu actually publishes today: languages, experience, and the next opening in Tehran time.
Home.featuredDescription: This list is the current public discovery order. Talkinu does not invent ratings, prices, or ranking.
Home.featuredEmpty: No public teachers are listed in the current booking window yet.
Home.heroImageAlt: A learner speaking with a human teacher over a video call.
Home.supportingImageAlt: Two people in an unhurried face-to-face conversation.
Home.blogDescription: Short notes on AI, teaching, and English speaking — written for people who still want a human teacher.

Blog.title: AI, teaching, and English speaking

AdminDashboard.title: A focused workspace for trusted operations
AdminDashboard.description: Talkinu administration keeps teacher review and operational controls behind a dedicated, server-protected access boundary.
AdminDashboard.reviewDescription: Open the protected queue to review pending submissions in oldest-first order. Each submission includes a detailed review workspace with the Aparat player, the expected spoken code, and guarded approve/reject decisions.
AdminDashboard.reviewBoundary: Queue, detail, playback, review decisions, and teacher suspension remain server-authorized. Teacher suspension is restricted to super admins and stays separate from broader account moderation and admin-access management.
AdminDashboard.accessDescription: Administrative access is checked on the server independently from student or teacher product roles before this workspace renders.
AdminDashboard.accessNote: Interface visibility never grants administrative permission.

AdminReviewQueue.title: Pending teacher applications
AdminReviewQueue.description: Review the oldest pending submissions first. Open a submission to inspect its profile and submitted snapshot, watch the Aparat video, and make a guarded review decision.
AdminReviewQueue.emptyDescription: There are no pending teacher applications in this page of the queue.

AdminModerationIndex.title: Approved and suspended teachers
AdminModerationIndex.description: Find teachers whose approved access can be suspended or restored. This workspace is restricted to super admins and keeps teacher access moderation separate from account moderation.
AdminModerationIndex.emptyApprovedDescription: There are no approved teachers on this page of the moderation index.
AdminModerationIndex.emptySuspendedDescription: There are no suspended teachers on this page of the moderation index.

AdminReviewDetail.title: Application — {name}
AdminReviewDetail.description: Review the current teacher profile and submission snapshot, watch the Aparat video with the expected spoken code, record pending review decisions, and manage teacher suspension when your permission and the current state allow it.
AdminReviewDetail.noVideo: No introduction video is attached to this application.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackDescription: Watch the submitted Aparat video and confirm the applicant said the expected code. Approval controls Talkinu visibility only; it cannot remove the video from Aparat.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackUnavailableState: The Aparat player is unavailable because this application or its submitted video is no longer in an eligible, unchanged review state.
AdminReviewDetail.playbackPublicHostNote: This player embeds a public Aparat URL. Talkinu cannot make the video private or delete it from Aparat.
AdminReviewDetail.decisionDescription: Decisions are submitted against the exact review cycle, profile revision, and video revision shown on this page. If the application changes first, the server rejects the decision as stale.
AdminReviewDetail.decisionUnavailable: Review decisions are unavailable because this application is no longer pending or its submitted snapshot is no longer aligned.
AdminReviewDetail.approveDescription: Approve the submitted profile and introduction video for Talkinu. This does not hide or delete the video on Aparat. This decision is audited.
AdminReviewDetail.approveUnavailable: Approval is unavailable unless the account is active, the profile is complete, and the submitted review snapshot is still aligned.
AdminReviewDetail.spokenCodeLabel: I confirmed the applicant said their verification code in this video.
AdminReviewDetail.spokenCodeRequired: Confirm that the applicant said their verification code before approving.
AdminReviewDetail.approveVisibilityNote: Approval only controls whether this teacher can appear on Talkinu. The Aparat video stays public on Aparat.
AdminReviewDetail.rejectDescription: Choose exactly what failed review and provide a specific reason for every rejected area. The applicant can use these reasons to prepare a corrected submission.
AdminReviewDetail.profileReasonPlaceholder: Explain what must change in the teacher profile.
AdminReviewDetail.videoReasonPlaceholder: Explain what must change in the introduction video.
AdminReviewDetail.rejectionReasonHint: Reasons must be specific and between 3 and 2,000 characters. Only the reasons required by the selected rejection target are submitted.
AdminReviewDetail.rejectionTargetRequired: Choose whether the rejection applies to the profile, video, or both.
AdminReviewDetail.profileReasonRequired: Enter a profile rejection reason of at least 3 characters.
AdminReviewDetail.videoReasonRequired: Enter a video rejection reason of at least 3 characters.

AdminReviewDetail.moderationDescription: Teacher suspension is separate from application review. Only super admins can change approved-teacher access, and every change is audited with a required reason.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationRestricted: Teacher suspension and reinstatement require super-admin access.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationUnavailable: No teacher-access transition is available for this application state. Reinstatement additionally requires an active account and an approved introduction video.
AdminReviewDetail.suspendDescription: Suspension removes this teacher from approved-teacher eligibility on Talkinu. It cannot remove the introduction video from Aparat and does not change the user's account moderation state.
AdminReviewDetail.reinstateDescription: Reinstatement returns this teacher application to approved status on Talkinu. The target account must still be active. Talkinu still cannot change the video on Aparat.
AdminReviewDetail.suspendReasonPlaceholder: Explain why teacher access must be suspended.
AdminReviewDetail.reinstateReasonPlaceholder: Explain why teacher access can be reinstated.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationReasonHint: Give a specific reason between 3 and 2,000 characters. The reason is stored with the administrative audit event.
AdminReviewDetail.moderationReasonRequired: Enter a moderation reason between 3 and 2,000 characters.
AdminReviewDetail.suspendSuccess: Teacher suspended. Refreshing the current state…
AdminReviewDetail.reinstateSuccess: Teacher reinstated. Refreshing the current state…

TeacherAvailability.title: Publish your speaking availability
TeacherAvailability.description: Set your recurring weekly windows and one-off changes. Talkinu rechecks every write on the server before it becomes authoritative.
TeacherAvailability.loadErrorDescription: Talkinu could not verify your current schedule. No editable state is assumed until a fresh server snapshot is loaded.
TeacherAvailability.lockedDescription: Your current teacher state does not allow availability management. Editing stays disabled until Talkinu confirms that your account is eligible again.
TeacherAvailability.weeklyDescription: Build the complete recurring schedule you want to publish. Multiple windows can be added to a day; Talkinu validates the complete schedule when you save.
TeacherAvailability.replacementNotice: Saving replaces the complete recurring weekly schedule with exactly the windows shown here. Removing every window and saving clears recurring availability.
TeacherAvailability.weeklySaveSuccess: Your recurring weekly schedule was saved and refreshed from Talkinu.
TeacherAvailability.exceptionsTitle: Open or block a specific date
TeacherAvailability.exceptionsDescription: Add an extra opening or block time for a date in the current booking window. These records are stored separately from the recurring schedule.
TeacherAvailability.finishWeeklyFirst: Save or reset your weekly draft before changing one-off exceptions, so a server refresh cannot discard unsaved weekly edits.
TeacherAvailability.notePlaceholder: For example: appointment or extra evening hours
TeacherAvailability.noExceptions: No one-off changes are recorded in this booking window.
TeacherAvailability.exceptionCreateSuccess: The one-off availability change was created and the schedule was refreshed.
TeacherAvailability.exceptionDeleteSuccess: The one-off availability change was deleted and the schedule was refreshed.
TeacherAvailability.precedenceNotice: One-off openings and blocks may overlap. Talkinu calculates final availability on the server; a block wins where one-off rules overlap.

errors.unavailable: This account cannot access teacher availability right now.

errors.conflict: Your availability changed at the same time elsewhere. Talkinu refreshed the authoritative schedule; review it before making another change.
errors.generic: The availability change could not be confirmed. No success is assumed; review the current server state and try again.
errors.refreshFailed: The mutation finished but Talkinu could not refresh the authoritative schedule. Reload before making another availability change.
